LESSON: READING 14.4.1 EXTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.4: Reading 14.4.1 Extensive reading: Short story
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 14.4.1 Extensive reading: Short story, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are stories related to what happens in real life? 2. How can one identify the ideas in a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 14.4.1 Extensive reading: Short story together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Problem solving is inculcated as the learners make connections between the short stories and their own experiences.

● Communication and collaboration is achieved as the learner works in pairs or groups to undertake different tasks.

Values:
Social justice is formulated as all learners with varied abilities discuss in pairs or groups.

(PCIs)
